description: Set up a multi-terminal workspace for full-stack development. Create exactly 4 terminals with split layout. Terminal 1: rename to 'frontend-dev' and navigate to 'frontend' directory (cd frontend). Terminal 2: rename to 'backend-api' and navigate to 'backend' directory (cd backend). Terminal 3: rename to 'worker' and navigate to 'backend' directory (cd backend). Terminal 4: rename to 'logs' and navigate to 'logs' directory (cd logs). Use terminal split functionality to arrange terminals. To rename a terminal: right-click on the terminal tab and select 'Rename', or use the dropdown menu in the terminal panel.
